features.name: Standalone Sigil navigation
features.description: The standalone Sigil shell exposes only the implemented product destinations.
features.expected_user_behavior: Overview, Portfolio, Proposals, Launch, Executions, Reconciliation, Audit, and Settings open without navigation errors.
features.development_build_test_method: Open every visible destination through the Electron development build and assert its expected heading.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Open every visible destination in /Applications/Sigil.app through loopback CDP and assert its expected heading.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: React renderer; no broker or backend connection required.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Navigation remains available with stale data and a disconnected backend.

features.name: Governance overview
features.description: The overview displays governance stages, masked account state, paper metrics, and pending proposal context.
features.expected_user_behavior: The user sees paper and simulation state, masked identity, fixed launch cap, governance stages, and unavailable broker submission.
features.development_build_test_method: Assert the overview safety labels and governance pipeline in the development Electron DOM.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Assert the same labels and pipeline in the installed Electron DOM.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Stale or disconnected state is visibly identified while the rest of the overview remains usable.

features.name: Stale and disconnected state disclosure
features.description: Stale data and broker disconnection are explicitly surfaced without enabling execution.
features.expected_user_behavior: A stale snapshot warning, disconnected status, and broker-unavailable explanation remain visible.
features.development_build_test_method: Inspect status text in the development renderer.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Inspect status text in the installed renderer.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: The UI stays usable in read-only paper simulation mode.

features.name: Proposal review and selection
features.description: Users can inspect proposal metadata, evidence, risk results, and contextual details.
features.expected_user_behavior: Selecting a proposal updates the contextual inspector without changing proposal status.
features.development_build_test_method: Select the second pending proposal and verify its contextual metadata.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Repeat selection and metadata verification in the installed app.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Proposal review remains read-only when the backend is disconnected.

features.name: Simulated operator action guard
features.description: Proposal decisions are disabled by default and require an explicit local-simulation enablement plus confirmation.
features.expected_user_behavior: Approve and Reject remain disabled until simulation actions are enabled; opening a confirmation never submits a broker order.
features.development_build_test_method: Verify ordinary controls are disabled, then use the token-gated disposable fixture to cancel, approve, and reject synthetic proposals through renderer-to-main IPC and inspect zero side-effect counters.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Repeat the isolated IPC fixture transitions in the exact installed application and prove the fixture is absent without the per-run token.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: Disposable in-memory certification fixture only; no production adapter or financial backend.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Controls stay disabled and proposal status remains unchanged.

features.name: Governed launch controls
features.description: Launch, suspension, and kill-switch controls are local simulation controls that are locked by default.
features.expected_user_behavior: Launch controls are disabled until explicitly enabled and the fixed $25 cap cannot be increased.
features.development_build_test_method: Verify all launch mutation buttons are disabled and the cap is read-only.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Repeat disabled-control verification in the installed app.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Launch remains suspended and broker submission unavailable.

features.name: Immutable execution receipt view
features.description: The execution view renders simulated, rejected, and outcome-uncertain receipt evidence.
features.expected_user_behavior: Receipt, order, symbol, broker status, duplicate prevention, and reconciliation state are visible.
features.development_build_test_method: Open Executions and verify all three fixture receipt states.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Open Executions in the installed app and verify the same evidence.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: An explicit empty state appears if no receipts exist.

features.name: Execution reconciliation
features.description: Outcome-uncertain receipts clearly require reconciliation and prohibit automatic retry.
features.expected_user_behavior: The reconciliation view marks uncertain outcomes Required and shows retry prevention.
features.development_build_test_method: Open Reconciliation and assert Required plus retry-blocked evidence.

features.name: Audit evidence filtering and expansion
features.description: Users can filter chronological audit evidence and expand sanitized event details.
features.expected_user_behavior: Filtering narrows events and expansion reveals sanitized JSON evidence.
features.development_build_test_method: Filter by a fixture order ID, expand the result, and verify broker_submission_attempted is false.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Repeat in the installed app and capture structured evidence.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Empty and no-match states are explicit.

features.name: Settings safety boundaries
features.description: Settings show paper-only mode, masked identifiers, fixed cap, and unavailable broker submission.
features.expected_user_behavior: Safety boundaries are readable and no credentials, live mode, or cap controls are exposed.
features.development_build_test_method: Open Settings and inspect the declared boundaries.

features.name: Local proposal explanation
features.description: Hermes Intelligence explains selected proposal evidence without authorizing execution.
features.expected_user_behavior: Explanation identifies its route and explicitly states execution and broker submission are unavailable.
features.development_build_test_method: Request an explanation and verify the governed result.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Request an explanation and accept either verified local bridge output or the explicit safe local fallback.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: A deterministic local-disconnected explanation is returned.

features.name: Read-only local backend bridge
features.description: Electron IPC permits backend health, durable runtime snapshots, proposal-only paper automation controls, and proposal explanation commands.
features.expected_user_behavior: Backend state refreshes continuously; start, pause, and stop affect only proposal generation; failures remain visible and fail closed.
features.development_build_test_method: Validate health/explanation responses and unsupported-command rejection.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Verify usable degraded state if the repository-local Python bridge is unavailable from the packaged bundle.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: Python and apps/sigil source plus a private local user-data directory.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Status becomes degraded and automation cannot execute or contact a broker.

features.name: Governed autonomous Alpaca paper execution
features.description: Startup enables bounded long-only Alpaca paper entries through the governed activation path while live execution remains unavailable.
features.expected_user_behavior: Mission Control starts governed paper execution automatically when every existing gate passes, shows bounded research progress and exact rejection reasons, and exposes only Disable while active.
features.development_build_test_method: Use mocked Alpaca responses to validate activation, deterministic ranking, persisted-before-submit intents, reconciliation, pause, and restart recovery.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Verify startup invokes the existing governed activation path, reports paper-api.alpaca.markets, exposes only Disable while active, and performs no certification order mutation.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: Authenticated Alpaca paper account for activation; ordinary certification remains mocked and mutation-free.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Missing credentials, stale evidence, broker ambiguity, or degraded runtime leaves submission disabled or reconciliation-required.

features.name: Electron IPC and preload contract
features.description: A sandboxed, context-isolated preload exposes only the bounded Sigil desktop API.
features.expected_user_behavior: Renderer can read build identity, backend/runtime status, control proposal-only paper automation, request explanation, and observe update status without Node integration.
features.development_build_test_method: Inspect window.sigilDesktop and validate all registered IPC handlers through safe calls or source contracts.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Inspect the preload API in the installed renderer and confirm sandboxed release mode.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Failed bridge/update calls return bounded error state.

features.name: Build identity and About & Update Center
features.description: Build ID, commit, build time, version, channel, and application mode propagate into the rendered application.
features.expected_user_behavior: The identity badge opens an About Center whose values match the packaged artifact.
features.development_build_test_method: Verify dev channel identity values in the Electron development renderer.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Verify release channel, packaged mode, version, commit, build ID, and build time in /Applications/Sigil.app.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: Build-time esbuild definitions and Electron additionalArguments.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Missing values display unknown rather than claiming a certified identity.

features.name: Updater status and failure handling
features.description: The updater checks the unchanged production release feed, requires user confirmation before downloading, and parses isolated current, newer, malformed, and missing local metadata safely.
features.expected_user_behavior: Development mode reports updates disabled; operators explicitly approve download and restart; protected paper work blocks installation.
features.development_build_test_method: Exercise the dependency-injected updater state machine and explicit internal test channel without network access.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Verify ZIP, latest-mac.yml, explicit download approval, defer, double install gate, and bounded update failures.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: Local-file deterministic updater fixtures; a published update is not required for isolated updater-logic PASS.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Display 'The update check could not be completed' and keep the app usable.

features.name: macOS arm64 package and installation
features.description: The production renderer is packaged as an unsigned local arm64 DMG and installed with a recoverable backup.
features.expected_user_behavior: The installed app launches from /Applications/Sigil.app with the certified artifact identity.
features.development_build_test_method: Build the production renderer and Electron bundles.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Verify Electron ZIP, package DMG, verify DMG, back up prior app, install, launch, and confirm executable provenance.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: macOS arm64, hdiutil, ditto, electron-builder, verified Electron distribution.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Stop with BLOCKED or FAIL evidence and preserve the existing installation.

features.name: Governed news workspace
features.description: Research-only governed Alpaca news collection, timeline, status, and advisory summary workspace.
features.expected_user_behavior: Selecting News opens the governed news workspace and permits research-only evidence collection without broker submission.
features.development_build_test_method: Open the News navigation destination and verify status, timeline, advisory summary, and governed collection controls.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Open News in the packaged desktop application and verify the governed news bridge remains advisory-only.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: Local governed news bridge and configured Alpaca news credentials.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Display a bounded unavailable or empty evidence state without attempting broker submission.

features.name: Ecosystem governed visibility panel
features.description: Read-only evidence surfaced from tools/computer_use/, sigil.hermes_webui_adapter, and an operator-configured Paperclip instance. No action is taken by this panel.
features.expected_user_behavior: Selecting Ecosystem opens the governed visibility panel and shows read-only computer-use driver readiness, Hermes WebUI target status, and Paperclip connection status without taking any action.
features.development_build_test_method: Open the Ecosystem navigation destination and verify computer-use, Hermes WebUI, and Paperclip evidence render in a read-only state.
features.packaged_build_test_method: Open Ecosystem in the packaged desktop application and verify the panel remains read-only with no destructive controls.
features.required_backend_or_dependency: Optional read-only Python bridge (tools/computer_use/, sigil.hermes_webui_adapter, Paperclip); every source is disabled by default and degrades to an unavailable state.
features.safe_fallback_behavior: Display a bounded unavailable or empty evidence state without attempting any destructive or mutating action.
